_comment: HOW MUCH OF THE CODE A RUN EXECUTES MUST HAVE A TEST BEHIND IT, BEFORE IT SPENDS.
_comment2: Read by orchestrations/scripts/lib/handlers/stage-coverage.js. Per project, because what a run costs is per project: there is no engine-wide default, and a stage whose project declares no policy is refused rather than waved through.
_comment3: thresholdPercent — the floor, checked per stage and again over every stage at pre-flight.
_comment4: blocker — true halts the pipeline on a shortfall; false reports it and lets the stage run untested code.
$baseline: 60% set 2026-08-31 by the operator as the working baseline for every stage. spec, reset and mint already clear it; the rest are the work in front. This is a floor to hold, not a target to stop at.
$blockerWaived: 2026-09-16, operator: the stage-coverage blocker is a REPORT for this project, as for regintel — the live claude run is the proof standard now (pj_strategy_live_claude_runs_with_cassettes).
